author: RV Services Team

changes: Automated shop assignment via Google Maps integration

claim_intake.description: Intake form for new glass insurance claims

automatic_shop_assignment.description: Automatically finds and assigns nearby repair shops

workflows.description: Main workflow for processing RV glass insurance claims from intake to completion

roles.name: glass_claim_user
roles.description: User can submit and view own claims

installation_steps: 2. Configure insurance providers in the Insurance Provider table
3. Set application properties in system configuration
4. Add API keys for Google Maps (if using real API)
5. Configure payment gateway credentials (for production only)
7. Set up user roles and permissions
8. Test claim submission via service catalog

testing.notes: All payment processing is disabled in PDI. Use test mode for all integrations.
